title: Reduce probe fanout and integrate region circuit breaker to stabilize autoscaling
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Problem: During regional traffic surges or partial network impairments, readiness/liveness probes from the control plane and autoscaler agents fan out to multiple replica pools and regions. That probe fanout amplifies load on struggling backends, causing cascading failures, autoscaler overshoot, and SLO burn. We have observed two patterns: (1) probe storms where N controllers poll M nodes and generate O(N*M) probe traffic; (2) probe-triggered autoscaler oscillation where transient probe failures cause aggressive scale-ups followed by rapid scale-downs when the probe success rate recovers. This ticket implements a multi-pronged mitigation: probabilistic probe sampling, hierarchical readiness gating, and a region-level circuit breaker that gates probe/scale actions when a region shows coordinated degradation. The solution must maintain fast failover for healthy regions and preserve SLOs (p99 latency and availability) while avoiding unnecessary scale churn and load amplification.
acceptance_criteria: Reduce probe-originated traffic to backend pools by >= 60% during simulated region partial outage in the lab environment (controlled fault injection)
Autoscaler oscillation rate (scale-up/scale-down cycles per hour) reduced by >= 70% under mixed probe-failure workloads
No increase in steady-state tail latency (p99) for healthy regions beyond 5% compared to baseline
Region circuit breaker activates when defined thresholds are met and prevents cross-region probe amplification; manual override available in Console
Instrumentation added: probe fanout metric, region_circuit_breaker_state, probe_sample_rate, autoscaler_derate_factor; dashboards and alerts created
Runbook updated with diagnosis steps and rollback procedure; postmortem template updated with new fields for probe-related incidents
tasks: Design: define probe sampling algorithm and parameters (sampling ratio, jitter, coordinated backoff)
Design: define region circuit breaker policy (error rate threshold, consecutive windows, derate factor, cooldown) and integration points with autoscaler
Implementation: add probabilistic sampling to control-plane probes and node agents with feature flag
Implementation: add hierarchical readiness gating so proxies/sidecars report degraded instead of offline when transient errors observed
Implementation: autoscaler: add derating logic when circuit breaker is open (reduce target concurrency and pause aggressive scale-ups)
Testing: fault-injection harness for regional partial outage (throttled network, increased latency, injected 5xx) and lab validation
Observability: emit new metrics, add dashboards, set alerts for early-warning signals
Rollout: gradual canary across canary regions (10% -> 30% -> 100%) with automated rollback on SLO regression
Documentation: update runbooks, Console UI help text, and API docs for circuit breaker controls
comments: 2026-01-29 Priya K: Initial triage - correlates with ENG-4921 autoscaler instability incidents from Dec/Jan. Proposal to try probabilistic sampling + circuit breaker. Added Miguel as owner.

2026-02-05 Miguel T: Spike notes - implemented local probe sampler prototype in a branch; sampling at 20% reduced probe traffic but caused longer detection time for node failures. Need hierarchical gating to avoid masking real fail-stop cases.
2026-02-18 Maya L (SRE): Reviewed design. Strong +1 for circuit breaker thresholds tied to both error rate and increased latency. Suggested metric 'probe_fanout_count' to make regressions visible.
2026-02-27 Miguel T: Implemented autoscaler derating component behind feature flag 'region_probe_mitigation'. Added integration test that simulates 30% packet loss to a region.

2026-03-04 QA: Load test results in staging attached to PR - sampling 15% + hierarchical gating passed canary with 2x sustained load; autoscaler oscillation down 78% compared to baseline. Need to validate cross-region failover latency.

2026-03-09 Security (Ana R): No secrets or new KMS interactions. Circuit breaker metadata surfaced in the control plane events — ensure RBAC on who can flip override in Console. Marked security_review_required=false but file a follow-up for Console RBAC check.
2026-03-10 Miguel T: Preparing rollout plan to canary in eu-west-1 then us-west-2; adding automated SLO gate: if slo_error_budget_burn_rate > 1.2x baseline halt rollout.
implementation_notes: Keep sampling deterministic per source IP for short windows to avoid global probe 'thundering herd' when sampler changes
Hierarchical gating: nodes/sidecars can return 'degraded' readiness which signals scheduler to reduce traffic weight rather than kill; this reduces disruption while maintaining detectability

Circuit breaker is region-scoped and influences both probe scheduling and autoscaler decisions. When open, autoscaler derates scale-up targets by configured factor and pauses ephemeral aggressive policies for cooldown duration
Expose runtime knobs via Console feature flags and API with guarded RBAC; default behavior enabled for P0 customers after rollout validation
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Over-aggressive sampling delays detection of real failures -> Mitigation: hierarchical readiness and conservative sampling floor (min 5% probes)

Risk: Circuit breaker open incorrectly causing reduced capacity in healthy regions -> Mitigation: require multi-signal confirmation (error-rate + latency + 5xx spike) and short initial cooldown with monitoring
Risk: Complexity in autoscaler logic causing regressions -> Mitigation: keep derating additive and behind flag; run long-duration soak tests and compare to baseline
rollback_plan: Flip feature flag 'region_probe_mitigation' to off (control plane) - immediate stop to sampling and derate behavior
Close circuit breaker state to 'disabled' via admin API and revert autoscaler config to last-known-good release
If telemetry shows SLO regressions after rollback, escalate to SRE on-call for manual mitigation and restore traffic routing policies
